role: Successful Caduceus network bandwidth measurement reply

evolution.missing_field_semantics: The measured fields are emitted on success; load_context is present only when the gate attaches a trace.

download.description: Download throughput in decimal megabits per second, rounded to one decimal place.

upload.description: Upload throughput in decimal megabits per second, rounded to one decimal place.

latency.description: Ping in milliseconds, rounded to one decimal place; null if that rounding overflows to a non-finite number.

error_responses.403: The administrative or command gate refused the request; the receipt names the gate signal.
error_responses.503: The measurement did not complete: unavailable launcher, failed or empty output, invalid JSON, or a missing or non-numeric download, upload or ping. The gate maps worker errors to its firstMissingSignal (normally caduceus-operation-failed), not to a speedtest reply with missing measurements. Worker join failure is also a staff receipt.

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
